cases.label: every actual combatant has four executable source actions; no source catalog mutation or implicit ownership
ammunition is consumed by ballistic primaries; contact and non-ballistic effects use cooldowns
returning to the personal kit retains its actual stock and cooldowns without refill or repeated return
workbook export is deterministic and covers all four modes with provenance and honest production states
actual reload, pickup and kit return retain 36/26/11/0 active reload ticks and the independent primary cooldown
pause cannot age a stored personal reload, and ordinary loot cannot shorten an active reload
aim feedback follows every current primary kit in all four modes without drawing randomness or mutating the run
contact and control readouts agree with actual reach, facing and successful actions at the boundaries
marking and shield feedback follow real damage rules, while non-damaging control remains valid
aim readiness follows independent primary cooldowns, reloads, empty ammunition and paused ownership
the actual aiming draw stays inside the reserved reticle and cancels camera shake without altering the hit marker
all 1,811 eligible identities resolve their actual primary delivery, without manufacturing art
real primary activations and cooldown ticks drive attack, recovery and ready states
every primary delivery has different geometry even with one colour, and pause rendering is pure
